text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup-steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up PowerShell
      uses: microsoft/setup-powershell@v1

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        winget install --id Microsoft.Powershell --source winget
        winget install --id Chocolatey.Chocolatey --source winget
        choco install -y posh-git

    - name: Run Copilot setup script
      run: |
        ./.github/scripts/copilot-setup.ps1
```

Please note that this workflow assumes you have a script named `copilot-setup.ps1` located at `.github/scripts/copilot-setup.ps1` in your repository. This script should contain the necessary commands to set up Copilot according to your requirements. If you don't have such a script, you will need to create it or adjust the workflow accordingly.
